summary: Bug Fix Verified: Mini-site sidebar navigation now correctly changes content when menu items are clicked. Root cause identified and fixed in MainSiteDashboardLayout.js - the siteTabChange event was not being dispatched when clicking sidebar tabs.

bug_fix_applied.root_cause: MainSiteDashboardLayout.js was missing the siteTabChange event dispatch in onClick handlers for sidebar navigation buttons. The fix was applied to DashboardLayout.js but MainSiteDashboardLayout.js had the same bug.
changes_made: Added window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('siteTabChange', { detail: item.tab })) to renderIconNavigation() onClick handler
Added window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('siteTabChange', { detail: item.tab })) to renderGroupedNavItem() onClick handler for tab items

sidebar_navigation.general_tab: PASS - Content shows Page settings, Name, URL (slug)
sidebar_navigation.media_tab: PASS - Content shows Header Image, Audio Player, Video Player
sidebar_navigation.styling_tab: PASS - Content shows Page Styling, Button Color, Background Color
sidebar_navigation.users_tab: PASS - Content shows User Access, Add user

context_for_next_testing_agent: The sidebar navigation bug in mini-site dashboards is now fixed. The issue was in MainSiteDashboardLayout.js where the siteTabChange event was not being dispatched. Test verified all 6 tabs (General, Media, Form, Styling, Submissions, Users) now correctly change content when clicked.

rca_of_issue.problem: Sidebar navigation in mini-site dashboard highlights icons when clicked but content doesn't change
rca_of_issue.root_cause: MainSiteDashboardLayout.js onClick handlers only called setSiteTab(item.tab) but did NOT dispatch the siteTabChange event that SiteDashboard.js listens for to update the activeTab state
reproduction_steps: Click any sidebar menu icon (Media, Form, Styling, etc.)
Observe icon highlights but content stays on 'Page settings'
rca_of_issue.fix_applied: Added window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('siteTabChange', { detail: item.tab })) to both renderIconNavigation() and renderGroupedNavItem() onClick handlers
rca_of_issue.verification: All 6 tabs now correctly change content when clicked
